tools.name: get_descriptor
tools.description: Return the Knox MCP server self-description: operator, USPTO patent reference, jurisdiction, available tools, and links to the public AAM (Agent Audit and Management) documentation surface.

tools.name: get_chain_health
tools.description: Return Knox service status (operational or degraded), total anchors written, the latest anchor timestamp, and the Bitcoin anchoring cadence (OpenTimestamps, 1-6 hour confirmation window). Mirrors the public /api/knox/health endpoint under the MCP envelope.

tools.name: list_event_types
tools.description: Return the canonical Knox event-type taxonomy. Each event type is a citation token for federal-grade audit; the registry expands monotonically and is itself anchored on every expansion.

tools.name: verify_anchor
tools.description: Given a SHA-256 anchor hash (64 hex chars), return the anchor record, chain link validity (predecessor present and matched), event type, sequence number, and verify URL. Public — no authentication required.

tools.name: anchor_event
tools.description: Anchor a generic agent action to the Knox chain. Accepts any event_type from the canonical taxonomy plus a payload object. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_chain_health" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return Knox service health: process uptime, database latency, total anchors written, latest anchor timestamp, and the Bitcoin anchor SLA target (OpenTimestamps interval, 1-6 hour confirmation window). Mirrors the public /api/knox/health endpoint under the MCP envelope." → after: "Return Knox service status (operational or degraded), total anchors written, the latest anchor timestamp, and the Bitcoin anchoring cadence (OpenTimestamps, 1-6 hour confirmation window). Mirrors the public /api/knox/health endpoint under the MCP envelope."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
